solutionSource.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

entries.clue: Stop following God as a result of war (11)

indicatorNotes.following: STATION comes after DEVA, so the stop follows the god

blocks.note: a deva is a Hindu god
a station is a stop on a line

annotation.surface: A population abandons its faith after the horrors of a war.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Stop' opens the clue like a command, but it is a noun: a place where the train stops.
annotation.definitionFit: Definition by example: widespread destruction is what war leaves behind.

entries.clue: Outstanding fight cut short (3)

indicatorNotes.cut short: the word is trimmed of its final letter

annotation.surface: A superb bout that was stopped early.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Outstanding' looks like praise for the fight; here it means still owed, as a bill is.
annotation.definitionFit: Plain synonym: an outstanding bill is one still owed, not yet paid.

entries.clue: Malicious individual quietly entering German square (5)

indicatorNotes.entering: P goes into the other word

blocks.note: vier is German for four, the number of sides on a square

annotation.surface: A spiteful person sneaks into a town square in Germany.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Square' is not a plaza here: it points to four, which in German is VIER.
annotation.definitionFit: Figurative sense: a treacherous, spiteful person is named after the venomous snake.

entries.clue: Shrink to hear the confession of Liberal (7)

blocks.note: to shrive is what a priest does on hearing confession

annotation.surface: A psychiatrist ('shrink') is asked to listen to a Liberal politician confess.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Shrink' reads as the slang for a psychiatrist who hears confessions; it is the verb meaning to contract.
annotation.definitionFit: Plain synonym: both verbs mean to contract and wrinkle, as a dried leaf does.

entries.clue: Fruit from Spain area decomposed (5,4)

indicatorNotes.decomposed: something decomposed has fallen apart, so the letters are rearranged

annotation.surface: Fruit shipped from a part of Spain arrives rotten.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Decomposed' fits rotting fruit perfectly, which hides its job as the signal to rearrange.
annotation.definitionFit: Definition by example: this crisp, apple-shaped variety is one kind of fruit.

entries.clue: Clumsy writer upset during sex (5)

indicatorNotes.upset: in a down clue, upset turns the word upside down, so it reads backwards
indicatorNotes.during: the turned word sits inside the other

annotation.surface: An awkward author is thrown off during an intimate moment.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Clumsy writer' reads as one phrase; split it, and 'Clumsy' is the definition while 'writer' is just a pen.
annotation.definitionFit: Plain synonym: lacking skill, awkward.

entries.clue: Nearly drink wine and die (7)

indicatorNotes.Nearly: the word is not quite complete, losing its last letter

blocks.note: NECK (to drink greedily) without its last letter

annotation.surface: Someone drinks themselves almost to death.
annotation.walkthrough: To neck a drink is British slang for gulping it down.
annotation.definitionFit: Technical sense: the verb is used of body tissue that dies.

entries.clue: Eats in mess, mostly (3)

indicatorNotes.mostly: most of the word, dropping its last letter

blocks.note: HASH (a mess) without its last letter

annotation.surface: Soldiers eating in the mess hall.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Mess' suggests the army dining room; here it is a hash, a muddle.
annotation.definitionFit: Plain synonym: to have a meal is to eat it.

entries.clue: Home Secretary welcoming two primates, one from the south, in disorder (9)

indicatorNotes.welcoming: the outer letters take the rest inside
indicatorNotes.from the south: in a down clue, reading from the south means reading upward, so backwards

blocks.note: the titi is a small South American monkey

annotation.surface: A minister welcomes a pair of monkeys, one arriving from the south, amid chaos.
annotation.walkthrough: 'In disorder' looks like an anagram signal; 'disorder' is the definition, a medical one.
annotation.definitionFit: Definition by example: inflammation of the liver is one medical disorder.

entries.clue: The Sun, and associated entities, thus stop claiming Scandinavian close to apoplexy (5,6)

indicatorNotes.claiming: SO and STEM together take the next part in between
indicatorNotes.close to: the close of a word is its last letter

blocks.note: to stem a flow is to stop it

annotation.surface: The Sun newspaper and its affiliates provoke near-apoplexy in a Scandinavian.
annotation.walkthrough: 'The Sun' looks like the British tabloid with its associated companies; it is the star itself.
annotation.definitionFit: The definition spells out the whole thing: the Sun plus its planets, moons and other orbiting bodies.

entries.clue: Proficiency of priest swimming in river (9)

indicatorNotes.swimming: the letters move about freely, so they are rearranged
indicatorNotes.in: the rearranged letters sit inside the river

blocks.note: the Exe is a river in Devon

annotation.surface: A cleric shows off his skill by swimming in a river.
annotation.walkthrough: The Exe is a short river in south-west England, a crossword favourite.
annotation.definitionFit: Plain synonym: both mean a high level of skill.

entries.clue: Phosphorus-containing fossil fuel, a product from trees (5)

indicatorNotes.containing: the fuel holds the P inside it

blocks.note: P is the chemical symbol for phosphorus

annotation.surface: A chemistry note describing a fuel that contains phosphorus and comes from trees.
annotation.walkthrough: The hyphenated 'Phosphorus-containing' reads as a technical adjective, hiding that it instructs P to go inside.
annotation.definitionFit: Definition by example: a resin from tropical trees, used in varnish.

entries.clue: Desire to capture back state capital (7)

indicatorNotes.to capture: YEN takes the next word inside it

blocks.note: to aver is to state firmly

annotation.surface: An ambition to retake a state capital.
annotation.walkthrough: 'State capital' reads as one phrase; 'state' is a verb in the wordplay and 'capital' alone is the definition.
annotation.definitionFit: Definition by example: it is the capital city of Armenia.

entries.clue: Feel very bad about vulgar complaint (6,5)

indicatorNotes.bad: the letters are in bad order, so rearranged
indicatorNotes.about: the rearranged letters go round the next word

annotation.surface: Someone feels awful about a coarse remark.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Complaint' looks like a grumble about vulgarity; it is an illness.
annotation.definitionFit: Definition by example: complaint means an illness, and this tropical disease is one.

entries.clue: Foot race primarily held in summer? (7)

indicatorNotes.primarily: what comes primarily comes first, so the first letter of race is used
indicatorNotes.held in: the letter goes inside the other word

blocks.note: one who sums, or tots up, is a totter

annotation.surface: A running race staged in the summer months.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Summer' is not the season: read it as sum-er, one who adds things up. The question mark flags that.
annotation.definitionFit: Definition by example: a pig's foot, sold as food, has this name.

entries.clue: Name English lake after dog (5)

indicatorNotes.after: E and L are placed after LAB, so the dog comes first in the answer

annotation.surface: An English lake is named after a dog.
annotation.walkthrough: 'After' reads as naming a lake in honour of a dog; in the wordplay it just orders the pieces.
annotation.definitionFit: Plain synonym: to tag something with a word is to name it.

entries.clue: Heavy defeat in round eight rankles initially (9)

indicatorNotes.round: BATTING goes round the other letters
indicatorNotes.initially: what comes initially comes at the start, so each word gives its first letter

blocks.note: in cricket the side that is in is batting
first letters of eight and rankles

annotation.surface: A boxer takes a pounding in the eighth round, and it hurts.
annotation.walkthrough: 'In round eight' looks like a boxing time-stamp; 'in' is BATTING, a cricket term, and 'round' is the wrap instruction.
annotation.definitionFit: Plain synonym: a severe beating, in sport or war, is a heavy defeat.

entries.clue: Ancient nursing home for those tweeting with sincerity (9)

indicatorNotes.nursing: to nurse is to hold close, so EARLY holds NEST

blocks.note: birds tweet and live in nests

annotation.surface: An old people's nursing home where residents post online, and mean it.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Nursing home' reads as one phrase; split it, and 'nursing' holds while 'home for those tweeting' is a bird's nest, not social media.
annotation.definitionFit: Plain synonym: the adverb means seriously and sincerely.

entries.clue: Notice one stops helping transmission (9)

indicatorNotes.stops: a stopper sits inside, plugging the other word

blocks.note: a ration is a helping, a portion

annotation.surface: Someone spots a single thing holding up aid being passed on.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Helping' looks like a verb meaning assisting; it is a noun, a portion of food.
annotation.definitionFit: Technical sense: energy sent out as waves or particles is being transmitted.

entries.clue: Scowled more than drunk lodger at University (9)

indicatorNotes.drunk: the letters stagger about, so they are rearranged

blocks.note: U = University, added to the fodder

annotation.surface: A landlady out-frowns her drunken student lodger.
annotation.walkthrough: The definition is a whole verb phrase, not just 'Scowled', so the answer is a comparative verb.
annotation.definitionFit: Compound verb: out- plus glare means to glare, or scowl, harder than someone.

entries.clue: King bathes for one week in stockings, perhaps (7)

indicatorNotes.bathes: to bathe something is to surround it with water, so LEAR surrounds the rest

annotation.surface: A monarch soaks for a week wearing his stockings.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Perhaps' marks stockings as one example of the answer.
annotation.definitionFit: Definition by example: stockings are one kind of clothing for the legs.

entries.clue: Put introduction to investing in mail (5)

indicatorNotes.introduction to: the introduction of a word is its first letter
indicatorNotes.in: the letter goes inside the other word

annotation.surface: Instructions to put a starter investment guide in the post.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Put' is the definition in its sense of propose, as in putting forward an idea.
annotation.definitionFit: Plain synonym: in the sense of proposing, to put an argument forward.

entries.clue: Penny films musicians (7)

blocks.note: a film is a thin layer, as of dust

annotation.surface: Penny makes films about musicians.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Films' suggests cinema; it means thin coatings.
annotation.definitionFit: Plain synonym: musicians play instruments.

entries.clue: Is prepared for flight, following projections (7)

blocks.note: f = following, as in page references

annotation.surface: A bird gets ready to fly, having followed others out along the ledges.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Following' looks like a joining word; it stands for F.
annotation.definitionFit: Technical sense: a young bird grows its flight feathers and gets ready to fly.

entries.clue: Start to recruit lowest of the low guards for meeting of rival pushers (5)

indicatorNotes.Start to: the start of a word is its first letter
indicatorNotes.guards: SCUM stands round R, guarding it

blocks.note: scum = the lowest of the low

annotation.surface: Drug dealers' rivals meet while the lowest thugs start recruiting guards.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Pushers' suggests drug dealers; in rugby union two packs of forwards bind and push against each other.
annotation.definitionFit: Cryptic description: the rugby set piece where two opposing packs push against each other.

entries.clue: In the morning, Mike consumes seaweed mixture (7)

indicatorNotes.consumes: AM and M swallow the seaweed between them

blocks.note: Mike is M in the radio alphabet

annotation.surface: Mike eats a seaweed concoction for breakfast.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Mixture' looks like it describes the seaweed dish, but it is the definition on its own.
annotation.definitionFit: Plain synonym: a blend of different things; originally mercury mixed with another metal.

entries.clue: Favour good competition (5)

annotation.surface: A plea to support a decent contest.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Favour' looks like a verb, backing the competition; it is a noun and the definition.
annotation.definitionFit: Plain synonym: goodwill or favour, as in being in someone's good graces.

entries.clue: Oscar overwhelmed by failing ability to speak (5)

indicatorNotes.overwhelmed by: O is swamped by, so sits inside, the other word

blocks.note: a vice is a failing, a moral flaw
Oscar is O in the radio alphabet

annotation.surface: An Oscar winner is too overcome to give a speech.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Failing' looks like an adjective about the speech; it is a noun, a vice.
annotation.definitionFit: Plain synonym: someone who has lost this has lost the ability to speak.

entries.clue: Canaries flying across India cause a great fuss (5,4)

indicatorNotes.flying: the letters fly about, so they are rearranged
indicatorNotes.across: the canaries spread across the I, taking it in

blocks.note: India is I in the radio alphabet

annotation.surface: A flock of songbirds flying over India kick up a racket.
annotation.walkthrough: The idiom takes its name from Cain, the troublemaking son of Adam in Genesis.
annotation.definitionFit: Idiom: the phrase means to make a great uproar.

entries.clue: Fan of VAT being raised (3)

indicatorNotes.being raised: in a down clue, raising a word lifts it bottom to top, so it reads backwards

blocks.note: a tun is a large cask, or vat

annotation.surface: A supporter of a rise in value added tax.
annotation.walkthrough: VAT in capitals looks like the British sales tax; it is just a big barrel.
annotation.definitionFit: Informal sense: an enthusiast, as in a football nut.

entries.clue: Type of music — a subsection of garage (3)

indicatorNotes.a subsection of: the answer is a section inside the next word

annotation.surface: A genre described as a branch of garage music.
annotation.walkthrough: Garage really is a music genre, which makes the surface convincing.
annotation.definitionFit: Short form: ragtime, the syncopated piano style, is often shortened.

entries.clue: Concerning baby smell is evocative (11)

annotation.surface: The smell of a baby brings back memories.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Baby' looks like the source of the smell; it is an adjective meaning small.
annotation.definitionFit: Plain synonym: something that calls up memories.
